data.name: Mine is the Gift
data.description: Whenever you manifest a psychometabolism power on another creature, including your familiar, you can expend your psionic focus to double the duration of the effect.  In addition, your familiar can merge with you.  When merged, the familiar cannot be targeted, is temporarily removed from any collective it may have been in, and gains fast healing 5.  The healing gained by the familiar while using this ability cannot be shared via collective healing.
